headline: What is the Discriminant?
sub: For ax² + bx + c = 0, D = b² − 4ac tells you the nature of the roots before you even solve.
subject: Maths

headline: Why HCF × LCM = product of two numbers
sub: Because each prime factor's smallest power (HCF) times its greatest power (LCM) rebuilds the original product.
subject: Maths

headline: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 — always
sub: It comes straight from the Pythagoras theorem applied to a right triangle. Memorise it; you'll use it constantly.
subject: Maths

headline: Tangent ⊥ radius
sub: A tangent to a circle is always perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact. This single fact solves most circle problems.
subject: Maths

headline: Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales)
sub: A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides in the same ratio.
subject: Maths

headline: Real image vs virtual image
sub: A real image can be caught on a screen (rays actually meet); a virtual image cannot (rays only appear to meet).
subject: Physics

headline: Why is the sky blue?
sub: Sunlight scatters off air molecules, and blue light (shorter wavelength) scatters much more than red — so we see blue.
subject: Physics

headline: What a dioptre really means
sub: Power of a lens P = 1/f (in metres). A +2 D lens has focal length 0.5 m. The shorter the focal length, the more powerful the lens.
subject: Physics

headline: Why series resistance increases
sub: In series, current passes through every resistor one after another, so the resistances simply add up.
subject: Physics

headline: What pH actually measures
sub: pH measures the concentration of H⁺ ions. More H⁺ = lower pH = more acidic. It's a scale from 0 to 14.
subject: Chemistry

headline: Why carbon forms millions of compounds
sub: Its tetravalency + catenation (chaining with itself) let carbon build endless chains, rings and branches.
subject: Chemistry

headline: Oxidation vs reduction (easy way)
sub: OIL RIG — Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain (of electrons). Or: oxidation = gain of oxygen.
subject: Chemistry

headline: Why aerobic respiration gives more energy
sub: With oxygen, glucose breaks down completely to CO₂ and water, releasing far more energy than anaerobic respiration.
subject: Biology

headline: Xylem vs Phloem (don't mix them up)
sub: Xylem carries water UP from roots. Phloem carries food (made in leaves) to all parts. 'pHloem = pHood.'
subject: Biology

headline: What a reflex action is
sub: An instant, automatic response (like pulling your hand off a hot pan) that travels through the reflex arc — no thinking needed.
subject: Biology

headline: Genotype vs Phenotype
sub: Genotype is the genetic make-up (Tt). Phenotype is what you actually see (tall). Same phenotype can hide different genotypes.
subject: Biology
